practice.on_first_use_open_question_bank: On first use, open Question bank and import questions. The bank, practice, and reports share the same local database.
practice.for_daily_practice_choose_a_que: For daily practice, choose a question count and select Start practice. Questions follow the selected tags. Strict test creates a low-distraction test.
practice.practice_contains_the_current_q: Practice contains the current question, answer and reasoning inputs, question queue, results, staged help, and question concerns.
practice.the_question_queue_shows_unansw: The question queue shows unanswered, correct, incorrect, skipped, hint, and answer-viewed states so you can return to a question.
practice.refresh_restores_the_session_qu: Refresh restores the session, queue, and current question. Answer and reasoning drafts are saved separately by learner, session, question, and state_version. Drafts are not submissions and are cleared after submission, skipping, answer reveal, or replacement.
practice.regular_practice_unlocks_level_: Regular practice unlocks Level 0-5 help according to effective error count.
practice.leaving_focus_view_does_not_del: Leaving focus view does not delete the test. Resume it from the saved session state.
practice.the_left_panel_lists_groups_the: The left panel lists groups, the center shows a question matrix, and the right panel shows attempts, first/final answers, help, answer reveals, explanations, and concerns.
practice.combine_keywords_source_stars_p: Combine keywords, source, stars, premium rating, status, and tags. Keywords match IDs, stem summaries, sources, sections, original numbers, and answer types.
practice.paginated_results_show_source_s: Paginated results show source, stars, premium and availability status, and last answer time. Paging does not change the active practice session.
practice.select_a_question_to_preview_it: Select a question to preview its full content. Administrators can also create repair drafts.
practice.in_administrator_mode_load_the_: In administrator mode, load the current question in the bank's governance panel to edit QuestionV2 and answer_spec fields, including content, answers, solutions, and stars.
practice.repairs_do_not_overwrite_old_qu: Repairs do not overwrite old questions. Create a draft first; the backend stores the reason, severity, notes, old version and answer snapshots, and a diff preview.
practice.publishing_creates_an_immutable: Publishing creates an immutable question_versions version and updates the current question and answer_specs. Old submissions retain their question_version_id and remain traceable.
practice.roll_back_the_latest_published_: Roll back the latest published repair to restore the previous question version and its saved answer specification.
practice.do_not_hard_delete_duplicates_e: Do not hard-delete duplicates. Enter the canonical question ID to mark the current question as a duplicate alias. It leaves future pools while versions, answers, tags, and submissions stay traceable.
practice.search_the_status_catalog_by_va: Search the status catalog by value, description, or model field to identify active, terminal, and practice-blocking states across tasks, batches, questions, answers, sessions, and repairs.
practice.diagnostics_make_no_real_ai_cal: Diagnostics make no real AI calls, consume no tokens, and do not change practice, reports, or bank data.
practice.each_final_question_normally_st: Each final question normally starts with 3 parallel candidates: structural observation, constraint transformation, and reverse construction. Choose 1-5 in advanced settings; only the highest-scoring nonduplicate is published.
practice.a_set_blueprint_defines_target_: A set blueprint defines target slots, same-star warmup/core/challenge positions, tag coverage, method diversity, single-numeric-answer requirements, and story-domain limits. Each item binds to a slot.
practice.advanced_settings_are_collapsed: Advanced settings are collapsed by default. Balanced uses 3 candidates, 5 non-AI positive examples, and 3 AI anti-duplicate examples per question.
practice.progress_shows_the_blueprint_cu: Progress shows the blueprint curve, slot coverage, score, and gaps. Cards show slot, warmup/core/challenge phase, and numeric-answer requirements.
practice.later_questions_are_appended_au: Later questions are appended automatically to the same generated-practice session, reducing waiting for large sets.
practice.fetch_models_retrieves_the_prov: Fetch models retrieves the provider's list. Test API checks the list and makes one very short chat request.
practice.normal_requests_time_out_after_: Normal requests time out after 30 seconds, transfers after 180 seconds, and AI answer reviews/concerns after 60 seconds. Controls recover and offer refresh, retry, or cancellation.
practice.use_question_concerns_for_displ: Use Question concerns for display problems, not solving help. Confirmed problems can trigger a same-star replacement.
practice.missing_a_200_question_database: Missing a 200-question database sample or gold-set file

practice.decimals_or_integers_are_accept: Decimals or integers are accepted, subject to the question's tolerance.
practice.separate_entries_with_commas_se: Separate entries with commas, semicolons, spaces, or parentheses; one entry per question or blank.

practice.counts_question_concerns_where_: Counts question concerns where AI reports question_problem=true with confidence at or above the threshold.

practice.uses_the_final_submission_time_: Uses the final-submission time for each session-question pair. Frontend timing events account for pauses and page absence before populating elapsed_ms.
practice.reports_use_current_submissions: Reports use current submissions. Question-repair regrading updates submissions and records submission_regraded events.
practice.answer_5_same_star_questions_on: Answer 5 same-star questions on recently practiced tags, aiming for at least 80% first-answer accuracy.
